title: Molecular engineering of D-glucuronamide additive directs (100)-oriented Zn deposition for ultra-stable zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7555-7567
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02101D, Paper
Le Zhang, Shuyu Bi, Xijun Liu, Qiangchao Sun, Tao Hu, Xionggang Lu, Hongwei Cheng
An electrolyte additive D-Glucuronamide (D-Glu) functionalized with hydroxyl, carbonyl, and amide groups and a 3D architecture is introduced to co-modulate the thermodynamics and kinetics of zinc plating/stripping synergistically.
